title.narrative: NISHTHA: Transforming Comprehensive Healthcare in India

description.narrative: (India): .The GOI's Ayushman Bharat mission aims to ensure universal health coverage for every citizen of the country. This is a bold paradigm shift for the GOI, moving from a selective and vertical primary care approach to integrated service delivery at the primary care level. ..With FY 2022 funds, the NISHTHA project will support the implementation of the Pradhan Mantri Ayushman Bharat Health Infrastructure Mission (PM -ABHIM) initiative through integrated TB, maternal and child health, and family planning activities. NISHTHA will provide technical assistance to strengthen the GOI's capacity to deliver comprehensive primary health care services to vulnerable populations. Interventions will ensure continuum of care vertically and a network of care approaches that include linkages to GOI insurance and social support schemes and will strengthen the quality of services delivered through Health and Wellness centers. The activity will address some of the systemic challenges and bottlenecks in terms of human resources career progression pathways, supply chain management, and community engagement by establishing institutional structures to strengthen Comprehensive Primary Health Care. USAID will provide support to fill service delivery gaps in reproductive, maternal, newborn, child, and adolescent health care and TB to reduce out of pocket expenditures and improve access to services for the most vulnerable populations in urban and rural India. Support will strengthen timely detection and treatment of TB patients much closer to their places of residence, thus decreasing loss to follow up and improving treatment completion. The activity will promote well-being across communities to decrease morbidity and ultimately reduce disease burden, while mitigating the impact of the COVID-19... ..Adaptation-Indirect key issue attributed funds will provide TA for operationalizing greener and climate resilient health facilities in all NISHTHA supported states....
